data.title: Split Transfer Chain Detection
data.description: Detects when a large inbound amount is split into multiple smaller outbound transfers to different beneficiaries in sequence. This layering technique is used to obscure the origin and destination of fraudulently obtained funds.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Split Transfer Chain Detection")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_large_inbound | near selection_multiple_outbound by account_id | count(distinct beneficiary_id) by account_id > 2")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:wire_system
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
transaction_amount>=25000
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT" OR event_type="INTERNAL_TRANSFER")
transaction_amount<10000
| stats dc(beneficiary_id) as unique_beneficiary_id by account_id
| where unique_beneficiary_id > 2

falsepositives: Businesses receiving large payments and distributing to multiple sub-contractors
Investment accounts rebalancing across multiple fund positions
